DEFT AGREES NOT TO CONTACT A PUBLIC AGENCY REGARDING THE PREMISE OR THE PLTF IS ENTITLED TO A $ 2,000 AUGUMENTATION. PLTF SHALL PAY $ 1,000 TO DEFT ROCHE WITHIN 48HRS OF A COPY OF JUDGMENT.
